description: Search the FIDES relying party catalog for verifier websites and services that accept verifiable credentials. Filter by free-text, country, owning organization, readiness, status, interaction mode, sector, and accepted credential format. Returns a compact, paginated list with canonical detail URLs.

featured.description: When true, only featured relying parties

readiness.description: Comma-separated readiness levels (OR): technical-demo, use-case-demo, production-pilot, production

search.description: Full-text search on name, description, provider, website, or accepted credentials

status.description: Comma-separated status values (OR): development, beta, live, deprecated

name: search_relying_parties
